title: Ted Serios' thoughtographs studied by Jule Eisenbud

tellings.quote: The PK Man. Another example would be Ted Cerios, the famous thoughtgrapher who was a Chicago bellhop studied by Juel Eisenbud, the psychiatrist who produced these images on Polaroid film.

plain: In the 1960s, a Chicago bellhop named Ted Serios was said to make pictures appear on Polaroid instant film using only his mind, which made him a famous "thoughtographer", and a psychiatrist named Jule Eisenbud studied him. The researcher Jeffrey Mishlove brings this up on the show, without naming a source, as one example of people said to affect the physical world with thought. If true, it would mean the mind can act directly on matter.
